candidates.name: Open Modelling Interface (OpenMI)
verified_facts: OpenMI enables runtime data exchange between process simulation models and between models and other modelling tools.
It originated in earth-surface modelling but is intended for numerical-model data exchange across domains.
semantic_limits: Runtime model exchange or simulation output is not a direct ground observation and cannot replace measured parcel elevation lineage.

candidates.name: Simple Feature Access – Part 1: Common Architecture
verified_facts: SFA Part 1 describes a common architecture for simple feature geometry including Point, Curve, Surface and GeometryCollection.
Geometric objects are associated with a spatial reference system describing their coordinate space.
semantic_limits: Geometry class and spatial-reference conformance define representation, not the positional or vertical accuracy of a parcel measurement.
